title: Akbar jawan abhi tere
body:
akbar jawan abhi tere marne ke din na thay
apne lahoo mein aap sawarne ke din na thay
<<DIVIDER>>
rukta nahi hai seene se jo khoon hai rawan
ay laal ye batado ke kis jaa lagi sina
apni riyazaton ka khazeena to dekh loo
akbar hatao haath mai seena to dekh loo
apne lahoo mein aap...
akbar jawan abhi tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum kya giray ho maqtal mein uth na saka hussain
tum ko sina lagi hai aur zakhmi hua hussain
aankhein jo tum churate ho dil chodte hai hum
tum hichkiyan jo lete ho dum todte hai hum
apne lahoo mein aap...
akbar jawan abhi tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
aulaad pe jab aata hai atharwan baras
khushiyan sameint laata hai atharwan baras
dulha se aap lagte thay har ek libaas mein
dil maa ka shaad rehta tha sehra ki aas mein
apne lahoo mein aap...
akbar jawan abhi tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasid khada hai pehlu mein ay laal dekh lo
sughra duayein deti hai aameen to kaho
rakhta hoo khat ko laash pe dilbar jawab do
sughra salaam kehti hai akbar jawab do
apne lahoo mein aap...
akbar jawan abhi tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sher e kibriya mujhe quwwat ata kare
laashe jawan uthane ki himmat ata kare
aankhon ka noor le gayi noore nazar ki laash
khyber ke dar se wazni hai mere pisar ki laash
apne lahoo mein aap...
akbar jawan abhi tere...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas ay raza kalaam ko kardo yahan tamam
mashgool e girya hogaya majlis mein khaas o aam
sadma badan ko akbar e zeeshan dete hai
subhe azan dete thay ab jaan dete hai
apne lahoo mein aap...
akbar jawan abhi tere...
author: Raza
